name: seocc
description: Work with your own self-hosted SEOcc (SEO Control Center) installation: what to fix first, search performance, opportunities, article ideas, the site audit, content briefs and the SEO change timeline, read and written through SEOcc's MCP server.

seocc_mcp_url.title: SEOcc MCP address
seocc_mcp_url.description: Your SEOcc installation's address followed by /mcp, for example https://seo.example.com/mcp. It must start with https://.

seocc_token.title: SEOcc MCP token
seocc_token.description: A token you create in SEOcc under Integrations > AI access > New token (it starts with scc_ and is shown once). Tick only the scopes and projects you want Claude to use.
